A Letter To You 🩷

I know that an apology alone can't solve everything.

I know that i hurt you in some moments,and i know that is taking a time to heal.

I'm not doing that to pressure you. I'm doing it because I want you to know that everything we shared was real and important to me.

If there is ever a chance for me to make things right, I want to prove it with my actions, not only with words.
🩷

One Last Thing...

Some memories deserve a chance.

I want to erase everything that happened,and I just need one more chance to talk to you again .

Thank you for every beautiful memory we shared. 🩷
